Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.socketconnector

Class ClientHandler

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.socketconnector.ClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
DisplayServerAppInterface
public class ClientHandler extends Object implements DisplayServerAppInterface
The ClientHandler establishes the communication between the LG client app and the server. The wire protocol is handled by a modular component so that we can use different protocols, the initial protocol uses Java ObjectStreams for expedience, this is not necessarily the long term plan. The conversation with the server is started with a number of bytes. int action action==NEW_CLIENT int protocol action==CLIENT_COMMS long clientID The protocol indicates which wire protocol this client will use and causes the server to instantiate the correct handler.
